thread:
alex: Heads up — deploy-bot just auto-bumped main to v2.3.5 for a docs-only merge (PR #4123). Did we want to bump for nonfunctional changes?

jamie: Ugh, no. Our intent was to skip bump for docs-only, but deploy-bot was tweaked last week. Right now it bumps on any merge unless label `no-bump` is present. :facepalm:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created tag v2.3.5 for commit 9f2a3c (PR #4123) — bump_type=patch — reason="merged to main"

maria: To be explicit: if change touches only `.md` files or `docs/` we should not bump. We should also avoid filling release notes with tiny wording tweaks.

samir: Two options: 1) path-based ignore in deploy-bot, or 2) require contributors to add a `no-bump` label. I prefer path heuristic — less manual work.

jamie: +1 for path heuristic. Quick regex: `^(docs/|.*\.md$)` — catches most cases.

maria: Also need to tweak the changelog generator to skip PRs that match the same filter, otherwise release notes will still include them.

alex: Could deploy-bot create an audit tag like `v2.3.6-patch.docs-skip` when it skips? I'd rather it not create tags for skipped bumps.

samir: Skip tagging entirely when heuristic matches. Emit a small audit event instead: `bump:skipped` with PR id and author. That keeps observability.

jamie: Implementation sketch:
```
# deploy-bot config snippet
bump_rules:
  - if: files_changed.match('^(docs/|.*\\.md$)')
    action: skip_bump
  - if: labels.include('no-bump')
    action: skip_bump
  - default: patch
```

maria: Add CI tests for edge cases: markdown generated by codegen, localized docs, and JSON-based docs outputs.

alex: What about translations or generated docs under `docs/generated/`? We might want to treat generated docs as functional (i.e., not skip).

samir: Good catch. Whitelist `docs/generated/` so heuristic becomes `^(docs/(?!generated)/|.*\.md$)` — skip normal docs but not generated.

jamie: I'll open the PR to implement that and add a `bump:skipped` event into the audit log. Will also update release-notes generator to ignore skipped PRs.

maria: Tiny nit: update CONTRIBUTING.md to call out the `no-bump` label as a manual override when path detection misses something.

alex: For rollback criteria: if a doc-only PR accidentally caused a bump, we should handle it like a normal patch rollback — revert tag, remove changelog entry, and note in runbook.

samir: Agreed. Add a short runbook step: `releasebot revert-tag vX.Y.Z` and open a follow-up PR removing the changelog line. Document who approves.

deploy-bot: noted: scheduled PR #5678 by jamie to change config. Emitting event `bump:skipped` for matching PRs.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll review #5678 later today.

maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-bot/pull/5678 — includes tests and changelog tweaks.

jamie: Merged and rolled out to staging, monitoring for any missed cases now.

alex: Nice. Can we also add a dashboard metric for `bump:skipped` vs `bump:applied` so we can detect regressions quickly?

samir: Yep — adding a counter to the audit pipeline and a small graph tile. Will alert if counts drop to 0 (likely config regression).

maria: Thanks everyone — should cut down release-note churn from trivial edits.

alex: I'll file a short release-note guidelines doc after lunch.

samir: Done: metric tile and alert added.

alex: Closing thread — follow-ups are PR #5678 and runbook update. :boat:
